scripts.build: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm -r --filter './apps/*' run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,files,gateway,cases,web -c blue,yellow,green,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @tms/auth-service dev " "pnpm --filter @tms/file-service dev" "pnpm --filter @tms/api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter @tms/test-case-service dev" "pnpm --filter @tms/web dev"
scripts.prisma:generate: pnpm --filter @tms/auth-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @tms/file-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @tms/test-case-service prisma:generate
